x11ynqb4.author: Plato
x11ynqb4.label: The Sun: the eye is the most sun-like organ
x11ynqb4.translation: Yet of all the organs of sense the eye is the most like the sun? By far the most like. And the power which the eye possesses is a sort of effluence which is dispensed from the sun? Exactly. ... And the soul is like the eye: when resting upon that on which truth and being shine, the soul perceives and understands and is radiant with intelligence; ... In like manner the good may be said to be not only the author of knowledge to all things known, but of their being and essence, and yet the good is not essence, but far exceeds essence in dignity and power.
x11ynqb4.reading: She calls the Sun simile "Platonic trigonometry". The eye is ἡλιοειδέστατον and stores the sun's power, so each eye is a sleeping sun; likewise the soul is ἀγαθοειδής, "Good-like", and each of us carries a small fiery sun within. The Good has light (truth, knowing) and heat (eros, φιλότης).

'I saw that I saw nothing' (beholding the Sun beyond the One)
sn9fbfu.note: Her reconstruction: emptying leads to birth, and birth to the vision beyond even the One. The wording is garbled in the transcript.

ducne9z.a_gloss: God, Zeus, an angel, the light
ducne9z.point: As long as you see something you are not there yet; the One is no 'something'.

d1qyjf9f.point: Change the way of seeing and it leads to deification.

d1h20065.point: The prisoner sees one direction only; Athena's owl turns its head and sees the whole.

p59asod.title: Fall in love with the Good
steps: Let yourself be 'sufficiently disappointed by becoming'
Rank the Good first, above everything
p59asod.why: Eros cannot be engineered, but you can let the flame catch.

p5vwoyu.title: Set your intention
steps: Before any inquiry, state your intention
Notice how it shapes your position and your vision
p5vwoyu.why: Πρόθεσις determines θέσις, which determines θέασις.

p1u37gjs.title: Act from the inner sun
steps: Take positions and help others awaken
Check that the action springs from remembered unity
Avoid both nihilism and hedonism
p1u37gjs.why: Action rooted in pure being unites rather than divides.

pbntsha.title: Do not stop at experiences or knowledge
steps: Value energy, astral or out-of-body experiences as stages, not goals
If you know high ideas and numbers, continue until you unite with the source
Be ready to let knowledge go
pbntsha.why: The Good is beyond knowledge; whoever stops to know it is stuck a stage before.
